headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, while the New York Mets secured a thrilling 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves. The Minnesota Twins took down the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5. In other news, the Colorado Rockies placed Tyler Freeman on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Tyler Freeman (Colorado Rockies) is out with lumbar pain, while Nathan Eovaldi (Texas Rangers) is dealing with right posterior elbow inflammation. Shaun Anderson (Los Angeles Angels) has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Devin Williams (New York Mets) is out with a right shoulder strain, and Caleb Kilian (Philadelphia Phillies) is dealing with a left oblique strain.

The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade, while the Athletics received Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the way at the plate, going 1 for 2 with a home run and an RBI. Jameson Taillon pitched 4 strong innings for the Red Sox, striking out 3 and walking 3.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the offense with a home run, four RBIs, and a 1-for-3 batting line. On the mound, Brent Suter pitched 3.0 scoreless innings with three strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Thrilling 6-5 Win Over Cardinals**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Andrew Painter earned the win for the Phillies, while Jonathan Bowlan secured the save.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Tyler Freeman on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right fielder Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to lumbar pain, effective retroactive to August 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Berry Joins Royals in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins on August 5, 2026. Berry joins the Royals' roster following the trade.
